strings.checklists.beforeExam.0: Bring your ID: you are identified by it and by biometrics.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.1: Check the date, time and address of the specialised PSC in eGov or the app. Arrive early.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.2: Medical examination on Form 073/u completed and shown in the system.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.3: Do several full tests against the clock: 40 questions in 40 minutes, no more than 8 mistakes.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.4: Study the diagram of your specialised PSC’s test ground and the order of the exercises.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.5: Go over the reference points for parking and turning round with your instructor.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.6: Get enough sleep and do not take medicines that slow your reactions.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.7: Comfortable shoes with thin soles: not heels, flip-flops or heavy boots.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.8: Do not take your phone or headphones into the exam room.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.9: In the car at the test ground, before the “Start” command: seat, head restraint, mirrors, seat belt, find the hazard lights button and the indicators.
strings.checklists.beforeExam.10: Remember: one failure is not the end. The first retake is scheduled for the very next working day.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.0: Walk around the car: tyres without cuts or bulges, pressure correct, tread at least 1.6 mm ⟦51⟧.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.1: No fresh puddles of oil or fluid under the car.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.2: Clean windows, mirrors and headlights. In winter, free of snow and ice, including the roof.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.3: Headlights, brake lights and indicators work.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.4: Carry your licence and the vehicle registration certificate (para. 9(1) of the Rules).
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.5: Seat, head restraint and mirrors adjusted; you and all passengers are belted ⟦52⟧.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.6: Phone in a holder, route set in the navigation before you start driving.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.7: Enough fuel and washer fluid; in winter, a non-freezing type.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.8: The car has a warning triangle, a first aid kit and a fire extinguisher.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.9: You are rested, well and sober ⟦53⟧.
strings.checklists.beforeDrive.10: Leave with time to spare, so that you do not have to rush.
